cohort: 140 women with abruptio placentae out of 16,082 deliveries at a tertiary care center in India between 2014-2019.
finding: The prevalence of abruptio placentae was 8.7 per 1,000 deliveries, and while several factors were analyzed as predictors of maternal and perinatal outcomes, only multiparity and maternal ICU admission were statistically significant (p = 0.023).
